meta.homeTitle: Dijital Asistan — Tells you what you need to know today, before you ask.

hero.title: Tells you what you need to know today, before you ask.
hero.lead: Understands your email, calendar and open tasks, and prepares a short briefing every morning. Nothing is sent without your approval.
hero.trust: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Your data is never sold for advertising.

home.briefingLead: Your briefing has six parts: Today's Priorities, Your Schedule, Expected From You, What You're Waiting For, Deadlines and Personal Updates. Every item shows where it came from.
home.brandNote: Gmail, Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple Calendar are trademarks of their respective companies; Dijital Asistan is not affiliated with them.

pricing.title: Start free. Go Pro when you need more.
pricing.lead: Your morning briefing is always free. Midday and evening briefings, meeting prep, smart follow-up and AI memory are Pro.
pricing.storeNote: Store price · incl. VAT · as of {asOf}
pricing.trialLine: New subscribers are offered a free trial of {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} in the store. The app shows whether you're eligible and what you'll be charged when it ends, before you buy. A valid payment method on your store account may be required.

support.title: How can we help?
support.lead: Find answers to common questions below, or write to us about anything else.
support.contactLead: Fill in the form or email destek@dijitalasistan.app.
support.deletionCallout: Want to delete your account or data? The Data Deletion page is the fastest way.

form.name: Your name (optional)
form.messageHelp: If it's about the app, include your device (iPhone or Android) and the version shown in Profile › About. Don't share passwords, verification codes or card details.
form.notice: We use what you send only to answer your request. Details: <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
form.privacyHint: To delete your account or data, use the <deletion>Data Deletion</deletion> page; it's the fastest way.
form.captchaFailed: The security check couldn't be completed. Try again.
form.serverError: We can't take your request right now. Try again a little later or email destek@dijitalasistan.app.
form.noScript: The form needs JavaScript; you can email us at destek@dijitalasistan.app.

deletion.title: Delete your account and data
deletion.lead: If you can't access the app, you can request deletion here with email verification.
deletion.codeStep: Type the 6-digit code we sent to {email}.

kinds.account: Delete my account and all my data

deletion.subscriptionNote: Your App Store or Google Play subscription isn't cancelled automatically.
